scope: Independent compact ROM callback proof review

finding_closure.finding: Coherent relocation of all spill operands could grant callback targets for an unrelated/peripheral/ISR byte.
finding_closure.resolution: Bind spill to unique one-byte _process_rgb_action_* XSEG allocation in process_rgb.rst; record symbol,address,listing hash. Missing,ambiguous,wrong-sized/wrong-space allocations and coherent relocation reject.
finding_closure.premise: Valid compiler object layout, no local address escape, separate IRQ allocation disjointness.

reviewed_invariants: Normalized nonzero byte/carry guard covers all possible incoming R5 values.
Modifier getter complete acyclic call tree only reads memory and changes A/R7/DPTR; R6 index preserved and R7 push/pop balanced.
ROM table offset arithmetic includes low-byte carry and excludes16-bit wrap.
Exact ROM getter, DPTR setter and indirect helper establish callback target provenance.
Saved R5/R6 plus LCALL contribute4 bytes during callback; helper/toggle/default/continuation paths also covered.
limits: Reviewed analyzer is an instruction/control-stack proof under stated data/architecture premises, not full memory or silicon safety.
All18-profile evidence is author-run; independent reproduction here covers one fresh full build.
